title: Calgary SPV-003 Construction of Exposed Building Face, Revisions 2 and 3
code_edition: Revision 2 explicitly states NBC(AE) 2019; Revision 3 names NBC–Alberta Edition without a year

facts.text: Revision 3 is dated February 12, 2025, accepted by CSTIC that date, and records the first edition (August 1, 2018) plus revisions 1–3.
Revision 3 names Division B Article 9.10.14.2 and Article 9.10.14.5 Sentence (1); it does not state a code edition year.

Revision 3 addresses single-storey detached garages and other storage/accessory buildings classified as Group F, Division 3 serving multi-dwelling buildings under Subsection 9.10.15, where those buildings do not directly serve the dwelling units they face.

Revision 3 states a minimum 1.2 m limiting distance between the dwelling unit and Group F, Division 3 building, including projections, and requires SPV-003 references in permit documents and permit conditions for the permit address.

The attached Revision 2 expressly names NBC(AE) 2019 and describes detached garages serving two to four non-stacked dwelling units; it says a modified scope requires the prescriptive path or site-specific variance.
Calgary's transition advisory says that from May 1, 2024, building permit applications are to comply with NBC 2023(AE)/NECB 2020, subject to stated multi-building transition conditions.

limitations: The SPV revisions are municipal standing variances, not individual project applications.
The current Revision 3 omits a code edition year; its 2025 date is not proof of edition.
Revision 2's 2019 edition and scope cannot be assumed to govern Revision 3.
The City page states advisory materials have no legal status and posted items may be removed.
